proc Checked:
  params:
    private gain = 0.0 {0.0, 1.0} => update_gain
  init:
    index: i32 = 0 {0..4, wrap}
    wide: i64 = 0 {0..4, clamp}
    values: f32[4] = [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75]
    evaluations = 0
    cached = 0.0
  def update_gain():
    cached = gain
  event set_gain():
    gain = 2.0
    ignored = 0.0
  def indices():
    evaluations += 1
    return (1000, i64(1000))
  sample:
    before = evaluations
    pair = indices()
    index = pair[0]
    wide = pair[1]
    left: f64 = 0.123456789012345
    right: f64 = 0.75
    swapped = (right, left)
    left = swapped[0]
    right = swapped[1]
    out1 = values[index] + abs(f32(wide) - 3.0)
    out2 = abs(gain - 1.0) + abs(cached - 1.0)
    out3 = f32(abs(left - 0.75) + abs(right - 0.123456789012345))
    out4 = f32(abs(evaluations - before - 1))

outs 4
init:
  checked = Checked()
  index: i32 = 0 {0..4, wrap}
  values: f32[4] = [0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75]
sample:
  checked.set_gain()
  index = 1000
  ignored = 0
  first, second, third, fourth = checked()
  out1 = first + values[index]
  out2 = second
  out3 = third
  out4 = fourth
